name: Pantry
description: Plans the food for community events. Order for who shows up.
avatarShapeWhy: The dome reads as a serving cloche: food arriving, lid about to lift.
avatarColorWhy: Closest Grok colour to Pantry's saffron (#F5A03A). The Bot colour also tints 1:1 messages and cards.

voice.why: Not auditioned: these are picked by name only, because the voices can't be heard from here. Audition all three in Grok Bot (voice chat) before the demo. Want: calm, warm, unhurried, clear on numbers, the host who has done a hundred of these. Keep whichever reads a headcount sentence most naturally.
voice.auditionLine: One hundred and forty-two signed up. Your last four drew fifty-eight percent, so I'm planning for eighty-five, plus eight spare. Two nut allergies, so the satay's out.
